summary.overview: Customer is moving a two-bedroom apartment from Atlanta to Charlotte and asked for a binding estimate before committing. They compared two other movers on the call and said price was the deciding factor.
commitments: Rep will send the estimate by email
Customer will confirm the elevator booking

findings.claim: The customer asked for a binding estimate before Friday.
findings.basis: Stated directly by the customer near the end of the call.

evidence.speaker: customer
evidence.quote: Can you get me a binding number by Friday?

evidence.speaker: rep
evidence.quote: Yes, I will email it tomorrow.

transaction_intent.rationale: Asked for a binding estimate and gave a firm date.
